events.title: Launch
events.text: Voyager 1 leaves Cape Canaveral on a Titan IIIE-Centaur, after its twin and on a faster route.

events.title: Into interstellar space
events.text: It becomes the first spacecraft to leave the heliosphere and begins measuring the interstellar environment.

events.title: Launch
events.text: Voyager 2 leaves Cape Canaveral on a Titan IIIE-Centaur.

events.title: Closest to Saturn
events.text: It passes 101 000 km from Saturn and photographs the spokes and kinks in its rings.

events.title: Closest to Neptune
events.text: It flies 4 800 km over Neptune's cloud tops, the closest of its four flybys, and photographs Triton.

events.title: The termination shock
events.text: It passes the termination shock and enters the heliosheath.

events.title: Back past Earth
events.text: It flies past Earth, about 559 km up at its closest.

events.title: Back past Earth
events.text: It flies past Earth, 1 171 km up at its closest.

events.title: Into Saturn
events.text: It plunges into Saturn's atmosphere, sending data for as long as its thrusters can hold the antenna on Earth.

events.title: Ida and its moon
events.text: It passes the asteroid Ida and finds it has a moon, Dactyl, the first seen round an asteroid.

events.title: Into Jupiter
events.text: After 34 orbits it is flown into Jupiter, to keep it from ever striking Europa.

events.title: Launch
events.text: Dawn leaves Cape Canaveral on a Delta II, bound for the asteroid belt.

events.title: The first craft at Saturn
events.text: It passes Saturn at a range of about 20 900 km, the first spacecraft to study the planet up close.

events.title: The last contact
events.text: The last contact with Pioneer 11, then 44.1 astronomical units from Earth.

events.title: Flying again
events.text: Discovery launches on STS-26, the first Shuttle flight after the loss of Challenger.

events.title: Launch
events.text: Mariner 2 leaves Cape Canaveral on an Atlas-Agena rocket, bound for Venus.

events.title: The course correction
events.text: It starts the one course correction of its flight, which aims it at Venus.

events.title: The first rock core
events.text: The rover seals Montdenier, its first core of rock and its second sample, in a tube.
